purpose: Facade and rooftop services pieces of Project Y2K's megastructure kit v020 (Blender script), re-derived as Almond library geometry. Library derivation (tools/prepare_organic_meshes.py, procedural route): Blender FBX import at the authored metre size, engine collision hulls (UCX_*) removed, recorded edits applied, kit material slots removed, weld/degenerate cleanup, triangulation, normals recalculated, hard edges kept; no decimation (the target is the source triangle count) and no subdivision. tools/build_generated_assets.py then scales the GLB to millimetres (height = the authored height) and puts the bottom centre on the origin.

origin.project: Project Y2K, the owner's game project (private repository)
records: Claude Code session transcript 46dbb3db-4ae0-456f-b4c3-0760f56623e6 (Write, edit and build)

excluded.SM_MegaNeonSign: Owner-chosen exclusion: 48-triangle blank neon sign, too little detail
excluded.world/neon_signs_v021 (ten Chinese neon: Lettering tessellated from Windows system fonts (font licences)
excluded.combat_v016/pickups: Game items (the ammo cell is weapon-adjacent)

dependencies.use: box(), tube(), finish() and the metre UV helper, loaded by path; its main() does not run

sessions.actions: Write of the script (2026-09-19T13:01:33Z); one scripted edit adding a louvre shelf to a tower module (2026-09-19T13:03:01Z), run in the same command as the kit build (FBX files and kit.json written 2026-09-19T13:03:12Z)

authoring.basis: Tool calls in the session transcript; the FBX files are newer than the last script edit.

external_reference_status: Owner-supplied reference images informed the kit design: the script's docstring says it was "modelled in Blender from the owner's 2026-09-19 reference images", six images the owner pasted into session 46dbb3db (kept in the project as docs/references/infrastructure_v020/1.jpg to 6.jpg; SHA-256 recorded in external_reference_files). They are third-party renders and photographs of dense city towers, rooftop antennas, AC units, pipes and scaffolding; they are not retained or distributed. No image was an input to any geometry: the script builds generic services pieces from boxes and tubes.
dimension_basis: Authored kit sizes in metres from the script (kit record dimensions_m); the library keeps them (height = authored height, width and depth measured). Wall-mounted pieces carry an assumed mount height (AC stack 2.5 m to its underside, pipe riser from ground level); the game placed them by script. Not a physical survey.
rights: Procedural geometry built by a Blender script in the owner's Project Y2K game repository (private); see each script's authoring record for the Claude Code session that wrote it, or that none was found. The owner's own project geometry: no generation provider, account or credits are involved, and the scripts build every piece from Blender primitives (no imported or third-party geometry in these pieces). Owner approved release in the Almond library under CC BY 4.0 on 2026-11-20 ("increase the range of models, from the ones i used for my project y2k games, (except for the operatives and bosses)") and chose the procedural kit pieces on 2026-11-20. Kit material colours and textures are not distributed; Almond materials are assigned.

kit_entry.note: 3 m satellite dish on a stand

assets.variant: 3 m dish on a braced stand
assets.reference_review: Reviewed on 2026-11-20: procedural geometry, so there is no input image. The prepared library mesh was rendered untextured from the front three-quarter view (500 px, viewed in a 300 px contact sheet) and the script code that models it was read: no lettering, logos, brand marks or characters in the geometry. The kit was designed with third-party reference images in view (external_reference_status); this piece is a generic assembly of boxes and tubes and copies no distinctive design from them.
